maddeler.e:
نندمل (form VII)
# نَنْدَمِلُ (nandamilu) /nan.da.mi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَمَلَ (indamala)
# نَنْدَمِلَ (nandamila) /nan.da.mi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَمَلَ (indamala)
# نَنْدَمِلْ (nandamil) /nan.da.mil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَمَلَ (indamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
